description: This file defines the MatchesBinary class, a part of the Twig templating engine, specifically handling the 'matches' binary operator which checks if a string matches a regex pattern.

classes.name: MatchesBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node for matching a string against a regular expression in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with left and right expressions and the line number. It also validates the regex pattern if the right node is a constant.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that performs the regex match check.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol, which is empty for this node.
